defects.description: The outcome of the refund event is misspelled, so a returned order can never reach refunded; every refund throws an unknown-state error.
defects.why_missed: The suite follows the shipping path and one return but never refunds; the refunded state exists in the table, so nothing looks missing until the event is exercised.

defects.description: canCancel only excludes shipped and delivered, so an order that shipped and was returned can still be cancelled, contradicting the rule that shipping ends cancellation.
defects.why_missed: The suite cancels from created and paid and never combines a return with a cancellation; the rule is stated in terms of history (once shipped) while the code checks only the current state.
